blocks.title: Questions we get on the call.

items.q: What if the engineer is not working out?
items.a: Say so at the fortnightly review, or before. A replacement is in your standup inside ten working days, and you do not pay for the overlap.
You do, on payment of each invoice. We keep nothing except what we have learned.

items.q: Do you work in our timezone?
items.a: Four hours of overlap with GMT every working day, the same four hours, so it is predictable. US teams: we shift the day and agree the overlap in the SOW.

items.q: Can we start with one engineer?
items.a: Yes. Most do. The minimum is one engineer for three months.
Your cloud bill, third-party licences, and travel if you ask us to visit. Everything else on this page is included.

blocks.title: If the numbers work, the next step is thirty minutes.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
